Across 3,948 patient/sample rows, Spearman correlation clustering of the 29 primary endotyping score signatures showed one dominant adaptive/lymphoid-protective cluster and one broader inflammatory/myeloid/SRS/detrimental cluster.

The tight adaptive/lymphoid-protective cluster contained: mars3_score, adaptive_score, yao_IA_score, protective_score, mod4_score, and lymphoid_protective_score. Its mean within-cluster Spearman rho was 0.778, with especially strong agreement between mod4_score and lymphoid_protective_score (rho = 0.962) and between adaptive_score and yao_IA_score (rho = 0.856).

The opposing broad cluster contained: mod3_score, monocyte_protective_score, myeloid_protective_score, mars4_score, wong_score, neutrophil_protective_score, yao_IC_score, mars1_score, coagulopathic_score, myeloid_score, myeloid_z_score, mod2_score, detrimental_score, myeloid_detrimental_score, lymphoid_score, lymphoid_z_score, davenport_SRSq, cano_SRSq, som_score, inflammopathic_score, mod1_score, yao_IN_score, and mars2_score. This broad group separated into interpretable subclusters: monocyte/myeloid-protective scores; Wong/neutrophil-protective scores; a Yao-IC/MARS1 pair; a MARS4 singleton; and a larger inflammopathic/coagulopathic/SRS/detrimental/myeloid-lymphoid dysregulation module.

The strongest cross-framework agreements were Davenport SRSq with Cano SRSq (rho = 0.922), detrimental_score with myeloid_detrimental_score (rho = 0.943), monocyte_protective_score with myeloid_protective_score (rho = 0.893), and Yao_IC_score with mars1_score (rho = 0.757). Strong negative relationships, including adaptive_score versus inflammopathic_score (rho = -0.842) and lymphoid_protective_score versus lymphoid_score (rho = -1.000), indicate that several schemes encode opposite directions of a shared adaptive/lymphoid-protective versus inflammatory/myeloid-dysregulated immune axis.
